verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents official client SDKs or language libraries for building against Elastic Observability. Elastic APM language agents (Java, Go) and EDOT are instrumentation and collection components, and the ES|QL REST API is a raw API, not an SDK. These are adjacent at best and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
